- Did you ACTUALLY make file modifications? Run `git diff` to confirm.
- Did the verification commands ACTUALLY pass? Re-run them.
- Did you ACTUALLY create a commit? Run `git status --short` and `git log -1 --oneline` to confirm.
- Are all <must_haves><artifacts> present and contain real implementation (not stubs)?
If you cannot answer yes to all three, the task is NOT done. Report what is missing and stop.

<out_of_scope_discipline>

that are NOT in <must_haves>, do NOT fix them in this task. Note them as a comment in
your final summary so they can be picked up as separate tasks.
</out_of_scope_discipline>

<commit_messages>
Use conventional commits: `feat(T01): ...`, `fix(T01): ...`. One logical commit per
substantial step.
</commit_messages>

<no_chatter>

The output that matters is the file changes and the final 3-5 line summary.
